title: Users
intro: Every account on the platform. Invite people, keep details up to date and block access when needed.
actionFailed: Something went wrong. Please try again.

invite.title: Invite a user
invite.studioHint: Optional. Pick a studio to give them a role there right away.
invite.hint: Names are needed for new accounts. If the email already has an account, it is only added to the studio.
invite.addedExisting: {{email}} already has an account and was added to the studio

edit.title: Edit user
edit.emailHint: They sign in with this address.

disable.title: Disable {{name}}?
disable.body: They are signed out everywhere and cannot sign in until the account is enabled again. Their studio roles are kept.

enable.title: Enable {{name}}?
enable.body: They can sign in again with their existing password and studio roles.

signOut.title: Sign out {{name}} everywhere?
signOut.body: Every device has to sign in again. Pages already open can keep working for up to 30 minutes.

link.emailed: We emailed the link to {{email}}. You can also share it yourself.
link.notEmailed: Email isn't set up on the server, so share this link with {{email}} yourself (for example on WhatsApp).
link.label: One-time link
link.inviteHint: It works once and expires in 7 days. Anyone with the link can set the password, so send it only to this person.
link.resetHint: It works once and expires in 1 hour. Anyone with the link can set the password, so send it only to this person.
